# Anne & Barbara Shaw

- [Anne](../character/anne.md) — Mentor of — [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md) — pupil attending Anne's school class · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) begins her first day teaching school, forgetting her prepared speech but managing her new pupils, including the sullen [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) and a bright, imaginative boy named [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). After school, an excessively dressed Mrs. Donnell visits to demand specific pronunciations and names for her children. On her walk home, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne.md) wild orchids, brightening her mood before she returns to recount her day to [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v2 · V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) writes a letter to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) detailing her humorous and charming experiences as a schoolteacher in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). She shares funny classroom anecdotes, excerpts from her students' compositions, and the story of how [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md) copied an old love letter for her assignment. Finally, she highlights a letter from her favorite pupil, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), about his imaginative rock friends.
>
> — v2 · XI Facts and Fancies

> Suffering from a severe toothache, [Anne](../character/anne.md) has a disastrous and irritable day at school, accidentally throwing a package of fireworks into the stove and later whipping [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. She returns home distraught over losing her temper, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts her. The next day, to Anne's surprise, Anthony shows newfound respect for her, which Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) later confirms was earned through the whipping.
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day
